source.label: OpenStreetMap contributors
source.method: Curated from named OpenStreetMap nodes present in the project's Overpass snapshot and explicitly tagged as drinking water, toilets, benches or individual trees. The source query was not an exhaustive amenities or tree survey; unnamed objects and relevant ways may be absent. No field verification was performed.

additionalSources.label: Greater London Authority Cool Space Data 2025
additionalSources.licence: London Datastore terms; no dataset-specific licence stated
additionalSources.method: GLA-listed point records from the local Cool Space Data 2025 extract, captured 11 December 2025 and clipped to the pilot bounding box. This historical extract is not the GLA's live Summer 2026 map and does not confirm current listing, opening, access or amenities.

additionalSources.label: Greater London Authority Public Realm Trees, November 2025
additionalSources.method: Build-time extract of records classified Highways in the source inventory, clipped to each pilot bounding box plus a 250 metre buffer. Records are inventory points, not field-verified current trees, canopy extents or shade polygons.

cool-space.note: GLA-listed sites from the local 2025 extract are included. This is not the Summer 2026 live map; listing, opening, access and amenities may have changed and were not field-checked by ShadeRoute.

drinking-water.note: Only named point records tagged amenity=drinking_water in the existing OSM snapshot are included. Operational status is not live.

toilet.note: Only named point records tagged amenity=toilets in the existing OSM snapshot are included. Access, fees and opening hours may change.

rest.note: Only named bench point records in the existing OSM snapshot are included. Most ordinary benches are unnamed and therefore absent. Shade is not implied.

tree.note: Includes GLA November 2025 inventory points classified as Highways within the pilot bounding box plus a 250 metre data-selection buffer, alongside the existing named OpenStreetMap tree points. The GLA inventory can be dated or incomplete; a point does not establish a current tree, canopy extent or usable shade.

notes: Seating, drinking water and toilets recorded in the 2025 register
